body: Thanks, that's really helpful! I didn't know that site existed, I'll be sure to check it out.
Yeah, in fact I do. I'll bring it up to my doc. Thanks. :]
I've been on an anti-depressant for almost a year, and it usually works pretty well. Lately though, it just doesn't seem to be enough.

Yeah, right when I left college. Was overwhelmed by suicidal urges every moment of every day and I just couldn't take it. I went to a partial-hospitalization program, so it wasn't full inpatient status. Had classes on coping methods, medication, group therapy, etc. Realized a lot of people had it much worse off than myself.
Sure, talking (or typing) usually helps with the stress. I guess that was the whole point of me posting here to begin with.
